[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Ledger integrity review + agl13 money-bug investigation (KAN-106–111)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://truesightdao.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-106
  - https://truesightdao.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-107
  - https://truesightdao.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-108
  - https://truesightdao.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-109
  - https://truesightdao.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-110
  - https://truesightdao.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-111
  
  Details:
  Covers the segment of this thread AFTER the earlier filed events (rows 15217/15218/15219, which covered the verify_dao_submission_landed ledger-target fix, its deploy verification, and KAN-94). Nothing here re-credits that work.
  
  WORK DONE
  1. Evidence-based review of the last ~3 weeks: commit cadence (~37 commits in 4 days, ~56% of subjects touching qr|verify|guard|ledger|sku|deploy|loop|jira), infra health (88d uptime, 0 service restarts, disk 44%), live sales/ledger state, and the OPEN_FOLLOWUPS backlog (279 pending vs 32 shipped = 8.7:1 arrival-to-close).
  2. Filed 6 Jira tickets from the resulting findings (KAN-106 through KAN-111), after duplicate-checking against pre-existing KAN-94/95/96/98/100/101/104/105.
  3. KAN-108 deep investigation (agl13 managed-ledger bug):
     - Read both GAS ledger scripts and confirmed they are NOT mirrored: sales_update_main_dao_offchain_ledger.js defines and uses normalizeAgroverseUrl_, while sales_update_managed_agl_ledgers.js never calls it.
     - Verified live 'QR Code Sales' column G value shapes before changing any parser, to avoid replacing one silent-skip with another.
     - PROVED MY OWN FILED DIAGNOSIS WRONG: the cause is not the strict !== 'https://agroverse.shop/agl4' compare. extractAglContractName() is a naive prefix-slice that turns a deep link into the raw path fragment "shipments/agl13/index.html", producing a corrupted liability row ("SunMint Tree Planting Contract - shipments/agl13/index.html").
     - Identified a second, worse hazard: the same fragment means a deep-linked agl4 URL fails the agl4 EXCLUSION gate, risking the same sale being booked into two ledgers (double-book).
     - Wrote a path-parsing replacement that returns '' for any non-identifier (so callers skip loudly) and re-gates the agl4 exclusion on the parsed name.
     - Built tests/gas/agl_contract_name_test.js in the repo's existing digest_test.js convention (plain node, vm sandbox, no deps), with fixtures taken from live column G: 26 assertions, 26 pass on the fix.
  
  VERIFICATION
  Negative control is the load-bearing evidence: the SAME test run against the UNFIXED source fails on exactly the corruption cases (returns "shipments/agl13/index.html", "shipments/agl4/index.html", trailing-slash variant) plus a TypeError on null input. The test therefore actually detects the bug rather than passing vacuously.
  
  HONEST STATUS — INCOMPLETE
  No PR was pushed and no GAS deploy was performed. The patch and test live only at /tmp/work_agl.js and /tmp/agl_contract_name_test.js on the autopilot host and are EPHEMERAL. Money-handling GAS deploy requires explicit governor approval, which was not given. Rows 685/686/696 in 'QR Code Sales' remain unbooked, so the revenue loss is still live. Ownership of the remaining tickets has been handed to a separate Discord channel at the governor's direction.
  
  TIME ATTRIBUTION (raw/direct split itemised, per convention)
  - Raw machine execution ~45 min: repo/GAS code reading, live sheet queries, patch authoring, vm sandbox test harness debugging (two runs lost to a missing setApiKeys stub, a harness bug not a code bug), control run.
  - Direct engagement/analysis ~45 min: the review and prioritisation judgement, ticket drafting with duplicate checks, the diagnosis correction, and deciding the ambiguity guard.
  Reported as a single event to close the thread; the split is itemised here rather than as two rows.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
